mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an imminent monetary easing policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation models and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation environment (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5%), the Federal Reserve's subsequent tightening of monetary policy leads to higher discount rates and reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profitability and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts above 1500 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1500, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a rapidly strengthening labor market, which increases household income and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
